versions.subject: Big Update
versions.detection:
schtasks_exe:
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/delete'
        - '/tn'
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Add more important tasks
        - '\Windows\SystemRestore\SR'
        - '\Windows\Windows Defender\'
        - '\Windows\BitLocker'
        - '\Windows\WindowsBackup\'
        - '\Windows\WindowsUpdate\'
        - '\Windows\UpdateOrchestrator\'
        - '\Windows\ExploitGuard'
condition: all of schtasks_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\schtasks.exe" CommandLine="*/delete*" CommandLine="*/tn*" CommandLine IN ("*\\Windows\\SystemRestore\\SR*", "*\\Windows\\Windows Defender\\*", "*\\Windows\\BitLocker*", "*\\Windows\\WindowsBackup\\*", "*\\Windows\\WindowsUpdate\\*", "*\\Windows\\UpdateOrchestrator\\*", "*\\Windows\\ExploitGuard*")
